mynavy-portal.title: MyNavy Portal PFA/CFA Calculator
mynavy-portal.notes: The calculator uses the model offsets from its dropdown data and the selected age, sex, and altitude 1.5-mile run standards for every bike. It rounds weight to the nearest whole pound, with half pounds rounded up, and drops fractional seconds from the converted time. The Integrity offset preserves the exact numeric value returned by the portal.

guide5a.title: Navy PRP Guide 5A, Physical Readiness Test
guide5a.notes: Guide 5A specifies reading the calories at the 12-minute mark and identifies the official PFA app as the source for stationary bike standards.

legacyApp.title: Official Navy PFA mobile calculator, supplied local archive
legacyApp.notes: The conversion coefficients and legacy bike offsets agree with the portal. In this version, the SL profile lists only INC / SL, and the Integrity offset is written as -5.2.
